subject: Detect SSL_new() returning NULL in outgoing connections (#2140)
reason: The change only alters behavior when OpenSSL's SSL_new() returns NULL inside createTLSConnection, i.e. under OpenSSL-internal allocation failure on a TLS-enabled server; when SSL_new() succeeds the code is behaviorally identical to the parent on both the accepted and outgoing paths. The fuzzer cannot reach this: tls-port is a provider-rejected config option, no installed component or artifact sets up TLS, so src/tls.c never executes in any deployment it can build, and no installed fault can make OpenSSL's internal allocation fail.
